section.title: Long-term memory
section.subtitle: Facts that outlive a session: one cell each for the project, the user and this repository
field.enabled.label: Enable long-term memory
field.enabled.help: While off, nothing is injected into the prompt and nothing may be written; the files on disk are left exactly as they are.
field.userProfile.label: Remember the user's own preferences (USER.md)
field.userProfile.help: While off the model stops producing the “what this user likes” cell and only project facts remain.
field.workspace.label: Remember facts that only hold for this repository
field.workspace.help: Each working directory gets its own copy, so switching repositories switches the cell. Turn it off and three cells become two.
field.globalLimit.label: Character limit for global facts
field.globalLimit.help: Counts the entries plus the `§` separators. Once full, the memory tool refuses writes and hands the current contents back to the model to merge.
field.userLimit.label: Character limit for user preferences
field.userLimit.help: This cell starts smaller than the facts cell: preferences are only a few lines, and the longer they get the less anyone reads them.
field.workspaceLimit.label: Character limit for this workspace's facts
field.writeApproval.label: Ask me before every write
field.writeApproval.help: Once on, every entry the model saves raises an approval card. Memory that keeps getting interrupted stops being written, so this is off by default.
field.reviewEnabled.label: Review memory automatically every few turns
field.reviewEnabled.help: On a review turn the model may only add memories, never change or delete them. Turn it off if it gets noisy and just say “remember this”.
field.reviewEveryTurns.label: User turns between reviews
field.reviewEveryTurns.help: 0 means no automatic review. Too small and it reviews constantly, cutting into real work.
field.pruneEnabled.label: Tidy up once when a session opens
field.pruneEnabled.help: Entries that were never cited and are already stale (60 days by default) move into an archive file; they are moved, never deleted.
field.pruneAfterDays.label: Days without a citation before an entry is stale
field.pruneAfterDays.help: 0 = move anything never cited; a very large number means no time-based tidy-up at all.
field.pruneNow.label: Tidy up now (moves only, never deletes)
field.eval.label: Usage review (injected / cited / dead weight)
field.eval.help: Mirrors codex's memory usage ledger: injected = turns where entries really reached the prompt, cited = how often the reply repeated an entry. Dead weight = entries injected for 3+ turns without a single citation (clear these first).
field.eval.text: {entries} entries · {injected} injected · {cited} cited · {rate}% citation rate · {dead} dead weight · {grade}
field.evalReport.label: View the review report
field.files.label: The three files
field.files.help: Just three Markdown files, with entries separated by a line holding a single §; entries that are not “fact” get a [feedback] / [reference] prefix. Editing them in a text editor works too, and the next snapshot picks up the change.
